mapper.select: WITH scoped AS ( SELECT id, identifier, name, data_type, unit, value, quality_code, collect_time, CASE WHEN quality_code = 'GOOD' AND length(btrim(value)) <= 64 AND btrim(value) ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' THEN btrim(value)::numeric END AS numeric_value FROM iot_device_property WHERE del_flag = '0' AND scope_verified IS TRUE AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND collect_time >= #{startTime} AND collect_time < #{endTime} ) SELECT identifier, max(nullif(name, '')) AS parameter_name, max(nullif(data_type, '')) AS data_type, max(nullif(unit, '')) AS unit, count(*)::bigint AS sample_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_code = 'GOOD')::bigint AS good_sample_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'GOOD')::bigint AS non_good_sample_count, count(numeric_value)::bigint AS numeric_good_sample_count, min(numeric_value) AS minimum_value, max(numeric_value) AS maximum_value, avg(numeric_value) AS average_value, min(collect_time) AS first_collect_time, max(collect_time) AS last_collect_time, min(id) AS first_property_id, max(id) AS last_property_id FROM scoped GROUP BY identifier ORDER BY identifier
